name: spectral_green.py
mathematical_scope: Computes a proposed dimension-independent inverse induced-1-norm ceiling for banded matrices with singular values in [a,b]; audits normal B=I+i alpha T and nonnormal B=I+i alpha T+beta U controls.
input_and_guard_coverage: Assertions require 0<a<=b,w>=0; first constructor has no n>=3 guard, second n>=4 and 0<beta<1. Inputs need finite real scalars and integer dimensions; the nonnormal/no-DD properties are asserted after construction.
costs: Dense SVD, inverse, and spectral-norm work O(n³) time/O(n²) storage, not a banded solver or complexity improvement.
test_evidence: test_phase19 covers n=8,64,256 with defaults; no parameter boundaries, NaNs, small n or alternative beta values.
acceptance_boundary: Analytic ceiling requires the accompanying band/singular-gap theorem. Computed norms are floating controls only. First function is correctly described internally as normal despite its name.
findings: L15–36 incorrectly unconditionally labels column diagonal dominance as failing for small n: n=2, alpha=0.75 gives column off-diagonal sum 0.75<1. n=1 is diagonal. L38–56 avoids this with n>=4 plus direct property checks.
